0.0: Can you help me, please? There's been a thief at the farm. I'm more than positive they were looking for the golden goose eggs. Good news is they didn't get to those, but the bad news is that they stole the regular goose eggs in the incubator. We gotta get them back before they hatch! Bring me back my #t3994871#s I'll give you some #b#e#t4310095#s#k#n. What do you say?

yes.0: Thank you. I don't think the thieves are that smart, mistaking regular goose eggs for golden ones like that. It must be the monsters lurking around the farm. Get back #b#e20 #t3994871##k#n items from them.

no.0: You'll need silver coins to purchase golden goose eggs, you know! We can help each other!

1.0: Did you get them all? Geez, I hope none of them cracked. Goodness knows monsters aren't the most nurturing types.

yes.0: The golden goose eggs are valuable, but these regular ones are valuable, too. After all they're both alive. You really saved some lives today.
